$schema_note: Single human source of truth for insurable routes. Consumed by: scripts/seed_routes.ts (governance whitelisting), api/cron/authorize.ts (sale-window attestation list), api/cron/weather.ts (surcharge base terms + rails), api/cron/reprice.ts (monthly advisory repricing).
